name: ledger-lite
intent: Write a small in-memory ledger HTTP service in Go: accounts, deposits and withdrawals, transfers with idempotency keys, holds that can be captured or released, a journal of every balance change, and frozen accounts.
contract: It is a single Go program, standard library only. It is started as `<binary> -addr <host:port>` and must serve HTTP on that address. Bodies are JSON; amounts are integer cents.
